subject.title: [Feature] 6 项改进建议：CLI 优先级、SecretRef 文档、update 透明化、token 登录、自愈审计

question: Which remaining #97971 requests should become core-owned work, and which should be folded into existing narrower issues?
rationale: Current main partially implements the bundle, but the unresolved pieces span stable CLI, update, gateway service, SecretRef, and audit surfaces where the repo policy requires maintainer product direction before automated repair.

options.title: Split into focused core items
options.body: Keep #97971 as an umbrella or replace it with separate docs/update/audit issues that each name the owner surface and proof path.

options.title: Route safe update to #14526
options.body: Use #14526 as the canonical safe-update workflow and keep only the SecretRef/systemd and audit gaps here or in new narrow issues.

options.title: Sponsor a combined operator-hardening feature
options.body: Treat the full bundle as one product initiative, accepting the higher review and compatibility cost across stable surfaces.

recommendation.title: Split into focused core items
recommendation.body: Keep #97971 as an umbrella or replace it with separate docs/update/audit issues that each name the owner surface and proof path.

likelyOwner.reason: This handle has the broadest recent history across update repair, audit CLI, gateway docs, and Control UI token behavior among the inspected paths.
